## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

pull_request.body:
## Summary
- 修复全局成功 Toast 被错误码适配为失败文案的问题，并保持错误类提示的安全脱敏。
- 将模型保存前验证收敛为一次文本连通性探测，移除流式与 JSON 串行探测。
- 统一模型创建与编辑为引导式界面，保留未修改的 API Key，并在服务端拒绝 endpoint 或协议变更时复用旧密钥。
- 兼容 legacy OpenAI 隐式 Base URL 配置及后端 nullable 契约。

## Validation
- backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests (3196 passed)
- node_modules/.bin/vitest run (999 passed)
- node_modules/.bin/tsc -b
- 本地 127.0.0.1:5173 /api/health

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Added model editing to the setup wizard with prefilled settings, retained API keys, enabled/default controls, and legacy endpoint support.
  - Disabled models can be saved without connectivity testing, including disconnected subscription models.
  - Added clearer success messaging for model tests and configuration updates.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Provider or endpoint changes now require a new API key while preserving existing credentials if rejected.
  - Model verification now performs a text connectivity check.
  - Success notifications consistently display localized text without misinterpretation.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
